family_selection: First existing ALGO07 RF influence-triggered family: summed c-arm omission displacement >=0.5 km, >=30 points, >=2 tracks; descending displacement, NORAD tie break. No case ID or evaluation truth selection.
extension: Scale all three existing selected-family physical orbital perturbation directions together, keeping unit Gaussian latent priors. No new modes or free affine terms.
normalization: Unmodified hierarchical_bound Gaussian logdet and Gamma terms, predictive normalization, and family evidence; fixed existing powers mean generalized evidence where powers<1.
starts: published fitted-c RF position and phase reference shared by both arms
fit_selection: Retain every grid cell; no GPS selection. Root supplies independent predictive comparison and combined model.
qualification: All original approximate and exact gates, predictive mixture gates and interior, optimizer success, phase closure, and no lost/reassigned native owners. RMS alone is never qualification.
evaluation_truth: Only computed after each RF fit; never read by prototype or used to choose family, prior, scale, start, or model.
